items.claim: Encoded slash in an ISR route becomes a path separator
items.consequence: For an ISR rewrite that carries an encoded slash in a dynamic segment, URLSearchParams.get decodes %2F to / before this path is restored. Astro's router keeps encoded slashes distinct while matching, so app.match can receive a different path and return a 404 or match a different route.
items.proposed_fix: Preserve the encoded path capture without decoding reserved escapes before assigning it to url.pathname, and add an ISR handler case for a dynamic segment containing %2F.

residual_risks: Vercel's platform routing and ISR cache were unavailable; the encoded-slash capture behavior could not be exercised against Vercel.
testing_gaps: The ISR tests verify generated routes and prerender configuration but do not invoke the built handler with x-vercel-isr: 1 to verify the query path is restored before app.match.
